mentions.name: Microlandia
mentions.description: A brutally honest city builder game uploaded to itch.io, where it has gained a small community with lots of feedback and iterations, now being worked on for a Steam release.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Microlandia, the brutally honest city builder. Posting this for a second time, because i’ve been working super hard on a steam release.

last month’s “what are you working on” thread impulsed me to upload this game to itch and 1 month later, i’ve got a small community, lots of feedback and iterations.
